title: Sync managed release pins for v0.96.0 and prevent release-plz drift
intent: After Cargo.toml version bumps, entrypoints/Dockerfile/specs must match the evaluating binary. Refresh 0.96.0 pins on master and add a workflow that auto-commits pin refreshes on release-plz PRs so validate drift checks stop failing every release.
stop_conditions: CI green on master after pin refresh
